flags.message: Stay application 25A622 was docketed 2025-11-25 and the 2026-08-14 as-stored snapshot still shows only the single arrival entry — no response request, referral, amicus, or disposition in ~9 months. Applications of this shape (pro se, respondent is the district court itself) are normally denied within weeks, so the dormancy may indicate a stale source docket or an uncaptured disposition rather than a genuinely pending application. I predicted on the pending posture the record shows and did not seek the application's own disposition.
